versions.provenance: 8th edition hepatocellular carcinoma staging, rewritten from criteria published on Medscape/public references; interim content pending the licensed content and R1 clinical verification.
versions.introduction:
8th edition staging applies to hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The 8th edition T category combines tumour number, size, and vascular invasion: T1 is a solitary tumour split by size and vascular invasion (T1a <= 2 cm, T1b > 2 cm without vascular invasion), T2 is a solitary tumour > 2 cm with vascular invasion or multiple tumours none > 5 cm, T3 is multiple tumours with at least one > 5 cm, and T4 is major vascular or adjacent-organ involvement.

A key nuance is that TNM mainly informs surgical candidates, because prognosis in HCC depends heavily on underlying liver function and performance status rather than tumour anatomy alone. The score-based systems (BCLC, Child-Pugh, and MELD) are used alongside TNM for treatment selection and are captured here under prognostic factors rather than in the TNM tables. Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma and combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma are staged with separate systems.

t.label: Solitary tumour <= 2 cm, or > 2 cm without vascular invasion
Solitary tumour <= 2 cm, with or without vascular invasion
Solitary tumour > 2 cm without vascular invasion
Solitary tumour > 2 cm with vascular invasion, OR multiple tumours, none > 5 cm
Multiple tumours, at least one of which is > 5 cm

Single or multiple tumours of any size involving a major branch of the portal vein or hepatic vein, OR tumour(s) with direct invasion of adjacent organs other than the gallbladder, or with perforation of the visceral peritoneum

n.label: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed

stageGroups.basis: Solitary tumour > 2 cm without vascular invasion, node-negative.
Solitary tumour > 2 cm with vascular invasion, or multiple tumours none > 5 cm; node-negative.
Multiple tumours with at least one > 5 cm; node-negative.
Major vascular or adjacent-organ involvement; node-negative.
Regional lymph node metastasis, no distant disease.

versions.regionalNodes: Regional nodes are the hilar, hepatoduodenal ligament, inferior phrenic, and caval nodes. Nodes beyond these (e.g., celiac, periaortic, pericaval) are considered distant metastasis.
versions.histologicGrade: Grade (G): GX not assessable; G1 well differentiated; G2 moderately differentiated; G3 poorly differentiated; G4 undifferentiated. Fibrosis score (Ishak 0 to 6) of the surrounding non-tumour liver is recorded as it carries prognostic weight.
versions.histopathologicTypes: Hepatocellular carcinoma and its variants (fibrolamellar, scirrhous, clear cell, and others). Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma and combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinoma are staged with separate systems.
prognosticFactors: Underlying liver function by Child-Pugh class (A/B/C)
Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer (BCLC) stage (0, A, B, C, D) integrating tumour burden, performance status, and liver function
Presence of cirrhosis and portal hypertension
